calculation_rule: Scores are sums of indivisible criterion points. EARNED receives all max_points; PENDING receives zero. The immutable 87-point baseline plus target_95_increment criteria preserves the 95-point checkpoint, and target_98_increment criteria add only the three evidenced multilingual points required for the 98 target.
